segments.text: I am also an orthopedic surgeon.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Helping people has always been my calling.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: On December 30th of 2020, I received my first Moderna shot.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Approximately one week later, my feet were numb.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Within days, my legs became weak.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I began to stumble, and ultimately, I collapsed at work.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Shortly after my collapse, I was diagnosed with transverse myelitis.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: a severe and potentially permanent injury to my spinal cord.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You see me standing here today, but what you don't see is the numbness, the weakness, and the nerve pain that I have had to endure over the past year.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Because of the severity of my symptoms, I was forced to face the reality that I was no longer safe to work as a surgeon.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My career that I invested 19 years of my life was likely over.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Days of supporting my patients and my community were replaced with isolation, disability, and doctor visits that seemed to go nowhere.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My adverse event was life-altering.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I was devastated.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Without the loving support of my wife, my four amazing children, and my close friends, I would have fallen into a dark place.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: funding love and support is essential for me and my vaccine injured friends.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Those of you here today, your support is essential, too.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: During this journey, I had the true blessing of meeting Brianne Dressen, whose life was altered by AstraZeneca.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I also met children like Maddie DeGerry, who is now confined to a wheelchair, and parents like Ernest Ramirez,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: who lost his son.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Their horrific and heroic journeys touched my heart.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I discovered one essential cornerstone of healing, the realization that I am not alone.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I am one of many thousands.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
